falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A break below the August 2024 lows would invalidate the 77% bottom pattern match, as that prior bottom held at higher levels; this would signal structural weakness inconsistent with a bottom formation and suggest new downside regime

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking near 28; sustained VIX above 35 would indicate panic levels exceeding that reference bottom, breaking the pattern's volatility signature and suggesting capitulation rather than bottoming

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury spread inverts more than -50 basis points (deeper inversion)
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom coincided with spread normalization toward -10bps; a sharp re-inversion would signal deteriorating growth expectations incompatible with the bottom_2024_aug pattern's macro backdrop of soft-landing pricing

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
